snippet.description:
Subscribe to Eton Messy: http://bit.ly/P7EPdo
Buy / Stream: https://VA.lnk.to/inseasonsscomp

Following on from the success of last years In:Season Compilation we return with the second in the series. ‘Spring/Summer’ packs some serious heat in the artist department, bringing back some stellar tracks from 2017, whilst offering up a wide variety of exclusives to get the party season off the ground.

‘What It Is’ by Alva is a bass line heavy roller which similarly to the previous, incorporates more live guitar elements to add to the power of the rhythm.

•Alva•

https://facebook.com/alvamusics

•Photography by Sweet Ice Cream Photography•

•Photo Link•
https://unsplash.com/photos/S9WMTzGVsW4

✖ Facebook http://on.fb.me/R5QGH6 ✖ Soundcloud http://bit.ly/LMFAUi ✖ Twitter http://bit.ly/PAcpsh ✖SPFYhttp://bit.ly/EMspotify ✖Google+ http://goo.gl/0a3TT4

Eton Messy have now fully arrived as some of the most influential tastemakers in the dance world. What started as a YouTube channel has evolved into a label, party series and production outfit that unearths and offers the freshest house, electronica, chill and lounge music to devoted fans everywhere. 

Early on the Eton Messy collective were early supporters of breakthrough artists like Blonde, Bondax and Maribou State. Their monthly mixes picked up a huge following around the world and as such demand for them to DJ around the globe became huge. They now do so each weekend and also host their own stages at various key festivals, as well as leading from the from the front with their Eton Messy label which has even lead to multiple takeovers on on BBC Radio 1. 

Releases from Jack Bandit, Just Kiddin, The Golden Boy and many more have all helped established it as an essential outlet for the newest sounds, and their new In: Season compilation once again proves they have their finger well and truly on the pulse.  Support for Eton Messy comes from not only from fellow Djs and dancers all over the world, but also those in the know such as BBC Radio 1 icons Annie Mac, Pete Tong, Danny Howard and Monki.

snippet.title: Mr. Ho's Orchestrotica, live at Alva's Studio in San Pedro, California (2016)
snippet.description:
Mr. Ho's Orchestrotica makes their west coast debut with a 4 date southern California tour.  Recorded February 20, 2016 at Alva's in Pomona, California.

Mr. Ho's Orchestrotica is a quintet and 22 piece megaband.  The quintet performs original music based on ideas from exotica and tiki of the 1950's/1960's, but using instruments found in Eastern European / Baltic music.  The 22 piece megaband performs the work of Esquivel who did not keep records of his sheet music.  Mr. Ho (Brian O'Neil) painstakingly transcribed many of Esquivel's best songs so it could be preserved, and faithfully performed live.

Set list:

00:00:48 Third River Rangoon
00:06:17 Autumn Digging Dance
00:12:51 Sansaz
00:23:14 Chiseling Music
00:31:22 Terre Exotique
00:41:12 Moai Thief
00:45:43 Phoenix, Goodbye
00:53:23 Prelude for Piano I
01:00:10 Prelude for Piano II
01:07:24 Prelude for Piano III
01:12:56 Shen Khar Venakhi
01:19:14 Maracatune for Chalco

NOTE:  The first 90 seconds were recorded on my smartphone because the show started while I was still getting set up.  The venue did not allow use of a tripod, so I had to shoot it handheld. I was so close to the stage I could not fit everything into view and had to pan back n' forth to capture the action.  Hence the shaky video.  Stabilization software was used to smooth the camera shakes, but has a side effect of introducing larger looping camera movements.

snippet.title: How To Defeat Alva - God of War Ragnarok Gameplay Guide
snippet.description:
How To Defeat Alva - God of War Ragnarok Gameplay Guide

In this video I give a few tips on how to defeat Alva in God of War Ragnarok. Alva is what I consider to be the first difficult boss in God of War Ragnarok. I went into this fight knowing it was going to be tough to mirror the Dark Elf boss from God of War (2018), but I wasn't expecting the fast combos at first. Luckily, once you understand the flow of the fight, the pieces fall into place.

Embark on an epic and heartfelt journey as Kratos and Atreus struggle with holding on and letting go
From Santa Monica Studio comes the sequel to the critically acclaimed God of War (2018). Fimbulwinter is well underway. Kratos and Atreus must journey to each of the Nine Realms in search of answers as Asgardian forces prepare for a prophesied battle that will end the world. Along the way they will explore stunning, mythical landscapes, and face fearsome enemies in the form of Norse gods and monsters. The threat of Ragnarök grows ever closer. Kratos and Atreus must choose between their own safety and the safety of the realms.

THE NORSE SAGA CONTINUES
A future, unwritten. Atreus seeks knowledge to help him understand the prophecy of “Loki” and establish his role in Ragnarök. Kratos must decide whether he will be chained by the fear of repeating his mistakes or break free of his past to be the father Atreus needs.

Instruments of war. The Leviathan Axe, Blades of Chaos and Guardian Shield return alongside a host of new abilities for both Kratos and Atreus. Kratos’ deadly Spartan skills will be tested like never before as he battles gods and monsters across Nine Realms to protect his family.

Explore vast realms. Journey through dangerous and stunning landscapes while facing a wide variety of enemy creatures, monsters and Norse gods as Kratos and Atreus search for answers.

#godofwarragnarok 

Thanks for watching How To Defeat Alva - God of War Ragnarok Gameplay Guide!

snippet.title: Tony Alva - Humanity Stoked Documentary Teaser
snippet.description:
Why is Tony Alva first? It’s personal.
.
We’re damn proud to release this first teaser footage of the Humanity Stoked Documentary, featuring Tony Alva, and here's why. I was born in Brooklyn, New York in 1966, and ten years later, my family relocated to Southern California. That move changed what skateboarding meant to me forever, and seeing Tony Alva in skateboarding magazines was part of the reason why. Just a few years earlier, Tony and his fellow Zephyr surfing team members asked Zephyr shop owners Jeff Ho and Skip Engblom to start a skateboard team, and an epic 40 year skateboard journey began for Tony.
.

For the last decade, Tony's been on a personal and spiritual journey as well. It's been a profound period of growth for him, turning away from the shallow trappings of ego and self-destructive behavior, and adjusting his value system to prioritize love, acceptance and being of service to others. As for me, back in 1979, at 12 years old, when my family returned to New York without having ever met Tony, I had no idea that 40 years later, I’d be sitting in recording studio with him, deep in a spiritual conversation for this documentary, and finding myself admiring him once again, yet for entirely new reasons. I could not have imagined that he and I would join together, along with so many other amazing people in the film, to help inspire others. I too have been on an journey of awakening, and along the way, I’ve learned that beautiful and amazing things await each of us, if we open up our hearts, accept ourselves, let go of fear, embrace uncertainty, and embrace one another in the process. Thank you Tony, and much love to you, Brother! .....@michael Michael Ien Cohen, Producer/Director
.
Be the change! This is a non-profit film, with all our revenue going to charity. If you believe in the mission of inspiring people to think more deeply about things that affect humanity, please like, follow and share. Together, we can all change the world.

It's been a profound period of growth for him, turning away from the shallow trappings of ego and self-destructive behavior, and adjusting his value system to prioritize love, acceptance and being of service to others. As for me, back in 1979, at 12 years old, when my family returned to New York without having ever met Tony, I had no idea that 40 years later, I’d be sitting in recording studio with him, deep in a spiritual conversation for this documentary, and finding myself admiring him once again, yet for entirely new reasons. I could not have imagined that he and I would join together, along with so many other amazing people in the film, to help inspire others. I too have been on an journey of awakening, and along the way, I’ve learned that beautiful and amazing things await each of us, if we open up our hearts, accept ourselves, let go of fear, embrace uncertainty, and embrace one another in the process. Thank you Tony, and much love to you, Brother! .....@michael Michael Ien Cohen, Producer/Director
.
